node.title: L1 general first-layout domination
node.statement: For any petal size ell, fix one admissible maximal sunflower source layout for a received word U, with M planted anchors. After subtracting its base polynomial, every listed codeword not among those anchors has the exact non-planted core-defect normal form in this same layout. Hence any selected source-admissible class has size at most its complete non-planted contribution in the first layout plus M; every possible later first-carried source-layout member is a first-layout anchor. At the L1 cutoff M=O(log n). This removes source-layout composition but not internal contributor-dependent quotient/Forney rechart payment.
